changelog:
- Major update: The skill is now focused on helping users turn vague ambitions into actionable two-week sprint plans, with an emphasis on work/personal balance and lightweight accountability.
- Skill documentation (SKILL.md) has been completely rewritten for clarity and guidance; previous technical details, examples, and implementation notes have been removed.
- Ten supporting and example files were deleted, resulting in a streamlined, user-focused package.
- Output and process now specifically center on conversational goal-setting, sprint theme creation, concise goal listing, and accountability setup.
- Audience and use cases are clearly described, targeting personal productivity, sabbaticals, job searches, habit resets, and more.
- Version remains at 1.0.0 with a new plain-English description and onboarding guide.
